bugs.name: Typo
bugs.flavor: Lives in variable names. Feeds on commits nobody proofread.

bugs.name: Missing Semicolon
bugs.flavor: Tiny, common, and somehow always reported on the wrong line.

bugs.name: Trailing Whitespace
bugs.flavor: Harmless. Invisible. Your linter's sworn enemy.

bugs.name: Unclosed Bracket
bugs.flavor: Opens things. Never closes them. Has commitment issues.

bugs.name: Off-by-One
bugs.flavor: Has exactly one more leg than it should. Or one fewer.

bugs.name: Flaky Test
bugs.flavor: Passes on Tuesday. Fails on Wednesday. Nobody knows why.

bugs.name: Merge Conflict
bugs.flavor: Half yours, half theirs, completely nobody's.

bugs.name: Timezone Bug
bugs.flavor: Works perfectly, except between midnight and 5:30 AM IST.

bugs.name: Null Pointer
bugs.flavor: There is nothing there. That is the problem.

bugs.name: Memory Leak
bugs.flavor: Slow, quiet, and a little bigger every day.

bugs.name: Infinite Loop
bugs.flavor: Has been running since 2019. Still going. Still going.

bugs.name: Regex Monster
bugs.flavor: Nobody wrote it. Nobody can read it. Nobody dares delete it.

bugs.name: Race Condition
bugs.flavor: Only shows up when two things happen at once. Usually in production.

bugs.name: Heisenbug
bugs.flavor: Vanishes the moment you attach a debugger.

bugs.name: Deadlock
bugs.flavor: Waiting for the other one to move first. Forever.

bugs.name: Works on My Machine
bugs.flavor: The rarest bug of all. Cannot be reproduced anywhere else.
